```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Purpose
Use an LLM (ellmer) to pull structured details out of each listing's description: what the price covers, extra fees, utilities, furniture, lease length and property type.

## Load keys and data
```{r setup2}
readRenviron("~/.Renviron")
nchar(Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")) > 0

combined = readr::read_csv("data/combined_listings.csv")
to_extract = combined |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(description))
nrow(to_extract)
```

## What we want the LLM to pull out
```{r type}
listing_type = ellmer::type_object(
  price_basis = ellmer::type_enum(values = c("per_person", "whole_unit", "not_stated"),
    description = "Is the listed rent charged per person/bed, or for the whole unit?"),
  price_period = ellmer::type_enum(values = c("per_month", "per_semester", "per_year", "not_stated"),
    description = "What time period does the listed rent cover?"),
  extra_monthly_fees = ellmer::type_number(
    description = "Total required monthly fees on top of rent, like a flat utility fee, in dollars. 0 if none are mentioned."),
  utilities_included = ellmer::type_enum(values = c("yes", "partial", "no", "not_stated"),
    description = "Are utilities included in the rent?"),
  furnished = ellmer::type_enum(values = c("yes", "no", "not_stated"),
    description = "Is the unit furnished?"),
  lease_length = ellmer::type_enum(values = c("12_months", "academic_year", "other", "not_stated"),
    description = "How long is the lease?"),
  property_type = ellmer::type_enum(values = c("apartment_complex", "apartment", "house", "not_stated"),
    description = "Is this a unit in a large apartment complex, an apartment in a small building, or a house?")
)
```

## Function to extract one listing
```{r function}
extract_one = function(i) {
  chat = ellmer::chat_openai(
    model = "gpt-5.6-luna",
    system_prompt = "You extract details from rental listings in Oxford, Ohio. Only use information stated in the text. If something is not stated, answer not_stated.",
    params = ellmer::params(reasoning_effort = "none")
  )
  out = chat$chat_structured(to_extract$description[i], type = listing_type)
  out$link = to_extract$link[i]
  return(as.data.frame(out))
}

extract_one(1) # test on one listing first
```

## Run on every listing and save
```{r run}
llm_fields = purrr::map_df(.x = seq_len(nrow(to_extract)), .f = extract_one)
readr::write_csv(llm_fields, "data/llm_fields.csv")
llm_fields
```
